item.title: Shirakawa-go from Toyama: Visiting Japan's Famous Gassho-Zukuri Village — Guide
item.description: Shirakawa-go, Japan’s most famous UNESCO World Heritage gassho-zukuri village, is technically located just across the prefectural border in Gifu, but Toyama Station serves as one of the most convenient gateways for visiting, with direct highway buses running in around an hour. The village’s steep, thatched-roof farmhouses, some over 250 years old, are especially striking when illuminated during limited winter evening light-up events, and the surrounding rice paddies and mountain backdrop make it one of the most photographed rural landscapes in Japan.
